response.original_title: [Passenger Guide] How Do I Add a Passenger on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise, you must call MSC Customer Service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise, you must call MSC Customer Service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or contact your travel agent, as additions cannot be processed online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, you must contact MSC Cruises customer service +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK) or your travel agent directly, as cabin capacity limits and lifeboat allocations require manual modification by the cruise line.
